user_job: Give this card a new address, right now
signature_device: Detached amber imprint struck below the press
cliches: contact card with a tap cue
notes: Reviewed from the rendered sheet at actual sizes (16-256px on light, dark and mid grey), the pixel zooms, both silhouette strips, and the four adaptive crops. Name-the-thing: the visual silhouette reads as a hand press at 128px and still at 16px, so the mark is a specific object rather than a shape on a tile. Legibility 4: the three-band structure survives the 16px pixel zoom; it is faint on white, but the shipped ground is the rust tile, where it is crisp. Distinctiveness 4: neighbourhood proof puts the nearest avoid-set neighbour (plus sign) at 0.196, well outside the 0.12 gate, and nfcraft's own contact-card mark at 0.483, so the sibling surface is not a variation of it. Balance 4: centred on 512; the grip's visual weight is carried by the wider platen. Color 4: rust ground with cream and one amber accent - warm, ownable, and a deliberate hue shift away from nfcraft's forest green. Scalability 4: platen 720u, grip 320u, neck 160u, imprint 380x144u and the platen-to-imprint gap 128u all hold at least two rendered pixels at 16px. Craft 4: four radii in one family, no stray detail, no crossing opaque elements. Second pass: the first draft put the imprint's corners outside the 40% maskable safe circle; tightening the composition to 154-870 and narrowing the imprint to 380u brought every extreme inside it without losing 16px mass.
